name: Physics
description: API for physics-related functions.

functions.name: connectDebugger
description: Connects the PhysX Visual Debugger.
This function is only available on debug builds.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The host to connect to.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port to connect to.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout in milliseconds.

functions.name: disconnectDebugger
description: Disconnects the PhysX Visual Debugger.
This function is only available on debug builds.

functions.name: isDebuggerConnected
description: Checks if the PhysX Visual Debugger is connected.
This function is only available on debug builds.

returns.name: connected
returns.description: Whether the debugger is connected.

functions.name: makeRigidStatic
functions.description: Adds a static rigid-body to an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to make a static rigid-body.

functions.name: makeRigidDynamic
functions.description: Adds a dynamic rigid-body to an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to make a dynamic rigid-body.

functions.name: makeArticulationRoot
description: Adds a an articulation to an entity and makes it the root link.
You can read more about articulations here: https://nvidia-omniverse.github.io/PhysX/physx/5.6.1/docs/Articulations.html.
Note that regardless of the `disableSelfCollision` setting (which affects _all_ collision within the articulation),
the parent and child of an articulation link will never collide with each other.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to make an articulation.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional configuration for the articulation. Set the whole table or individual properties to `nil` to use defaults.

functions.name: makeArticulationLink
functions.description: Adds an articulation link rigid-body to an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to make an articulation link.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The parent entity. Must have an articulation link already.

functions.name: removePhysics
functions.description: Removes the static or dynamic rigid-body attached to an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to remove physics from.

functions.name: isRigidStatic
functions.description: Checks whether the entity is a static rigid-body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isRigidStatic
returns.description: Whether the entity is a static rigid-body.

functions.name: isRigidDynamic
functions.description: Checks whether the entity is a dynamic rigid-body. This includes articulation links.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isRigidDynamic
returns.description: Whether the entity is a dynamic rigid-body.

functions.name: isArticulationRoot
functions.description: Checks whether the entity is the root of an articulation.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isArticulationRoot
returns.description: Whether the entity is an articulation root.

functions.name: isArticulationLink
functions.description: Checks whether the entity is a link of an articulation.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isArticulationLink
returns.description: Whether the entity is an articulation link.

functions.name: addToScene
description: Adds the entity's rigid-body to the physics scene, making it active in collision detection and scene queries.
Note that articulations cannot be modified after being added to the scene.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to add.

functions.name: removeFromScene
functions.description: Removes the entity's rigid-body from the physics scene, making it inactive in collision detection and scene queries.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to remove.

functions.name: isInScene
functions.description: Checks whether the entity's rigid-body has been added to the physics scene.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to check.

returns.name: isInScene
returns.description: Whether the entity is in the scene.

functions.name: wake
description: Forces the entity's rigid-body to wake up.
The physics engine will pause the simulation of rigid-bodies which have not significantly changed their state for a period of time,
and will wake them automatically if another object interacts with them.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to wake.

functions.name: sleep
functions.description: Forces the entity's rigid-body to sleep, pausing its simulation until awoken manually or by another object.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to sleep.

functions.name: isSleeping
functions.description: Checks whether the entity's rigid-body has its simulation paused.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to check.

returns.name: isSleeping
returns.description: Whether the entity is sleeping.

functions.name: getMass
functions.description: Gets the mass of a rigid-body entity or collider.

parameters.name: entityOrCollider
parameters.description: The entity or collider to get the mass of.

returns.name: mass
returns.description: The mass of the object.

functions.name: setMass
description: Sets the mass of a rigid-body entity or collider.
You should update the inertia tensor when modifying the mass of a rigid-body.
You can either calculate this by hand, or use the helper methods `setMassAndUpdateInertia` and `updateMassAndInertiaFromColliders`.

parameters.name: entityOrCollider
parameters.description: The entity or collider to set the mass of.

parameters.name: mass
parameters.description: The mass to set.

functions.name: getCentreOfMass
functions.description: Gets the centre of mass of a rigid-body entity or collider, in local space.

parameters.name: entityOrCollider
parameters.description: The entity or collider to get the centre of mass of.

returns.name: centreOfMass
returns.description: The centre of mass of the object.

functions.name: setCentreOfMass
description: Sets the mass of a rigid-body entity or collider.
You should update the inertia tensor when modifying the centre of mass of a rigid-body.
You can either calculate this by hand, or use the helper methods `setMassAndUpdateInertia` and `updateMassAndInertiaFromColliders`.

parameters.name: entityOrCollider
parameters.description: The entity or collider to set the centre of mass of.

parameters.name: centreOfMass
parameters.description: The centre of mass to set.

functions.name: getInertiaDiagonal
functions.description: Gets the diagonal inertia tensor of an entity's rigid-body

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to get the inertia diagonal of.

returns.name: inertiaDiagonal
returns.description: The diagonal inertia tensor.

functions.name: setInertiaDiagonal
description: Sets the diagonal inertia tensor of an entity's rigid-body.
In most cases you should use the `setMassAndUpdateInertia` and `updateMassAndInertiaFromColliders` methods instead.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to set the inertia diagonal of.

parameters.name: inertiaDiagonal
parameters.description: The diagonal inertia tensor.

functions.name: getInertiaOrientation
functions.description: Gets the orientation in which the diagonal inertia tensor of an entity's rigid-body applies.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to get the inertia orientation of.

returns.name: inertiaOrientation
returns.description: The orientation of the inertia tensor.

functions.name: setInertiaOrientation
description: Sets the orientation in which the diagonal inertia tensor of an entity's rigid-body applies.
In most cases you should use the `setMassAndUpdateInertia` and `updateMassAndInertiaFromColliders` methods instead.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to set the inertia orientation of.

parameters.name: inertiaOrientation
parameters.description: The orientation of the inertia tensor.

functions.name: setMassAndUpdateInertia
description: Sets the mass properties of an entity's rigid-body and updates the inertia tensor to match.
This method assumes a uniform density of `1` for all attached colliders.
For rigid-bodies of mixed density, use `updateMassAndInertiaFromColliders` or calculate the inertia tensor by hand.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to set the mass properties of.

parameters.name: mass
parameters.description: Total mass of the rigid-body across all colliders.

parameters.name: centreOfMass
parameters.description: Overall centre of mass of the rigid-body, in local space.

functions.name: updateMassAndInertiaFromColliders
functions.description: Updates the mass and inertia of an entity's rigid-body to match its attached colliders.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to update the mass and inertia of.

functions.name: getLinearDamping
functions.description: Gets the linear damping of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

returns.name: damping
returns.description: The linear damping of the rigid body.

functions.name: setLinearDamping
functions.description: Sets the linear damping of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: The linear damping to set.

functions.name: getAngularDamping
functions.description: Gets the angular damping of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

returns.name: damping
returns.description: The angular damping of the rigid body.

functions.name: setAngularDamping
functions.description: Sets the angular damping of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: The angular damping to set.

functions.name: setLinearVelocity
description: Sets the linear velocity of an entity.
The entity must have a rigid body for velocity to be applied each tick automatically.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to set the velocity of.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The linear velocity to set.

functions.name: getLinearVelocity
functions.description: Gets the linear velocity of an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to get the velocity of.

returns.name: velocity
returns.description: The linear velocity of the entity.

functions.name: setAngularVelocity
description: Sets the angular velocity of an entity.
The entity must have a rigid body for velocity to be applied each tick automatically.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to set the velocity of.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The angular velocity to set.

functions.name: getAngularVelocity
functions.description: Gets the angular velocity of an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to get the velocity of.

returns.name: velocity
returns.description: The angular velocity of the entity.

functions.name: getVelocityAtPosition
description: Gets the velocity of a point in world space if it were attached to the rigid body,
taking into account both the linear and angular velocity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: World space position to read the velocity of.

returns.name: velocity
returns.description: The velocity of the world space position.

functions.name: getLinearAcceleration
functions.description: Gets the linear acceleration of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

returns.name: acceleration
returns.description: The linear acceleration of the rigid body.

functions.name: getAngularAcceleration
functions.description: Gets the angular acceleration of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

returns.name: acceleration
returns.description: The angular acceleration of the rigid body.

functions.name: addForce
description: Adds a force to a rigid body.
#### Force accumulation
Forces are accumulated until the next physics step.
To clear the accumulated forces, call [clearForce](#Physics.clearForce).

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: The force to add.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The force mode.

functions.name: addTorque
description: Adds a torque to a rigid body.
#### Torque accumulation
Torques are accumulated until the next physics step.
To clear the accumulated torques, call [clearTorque](#Physics.clearTorque).

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: torque
parameters.description: The torque to add.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The force mode.

functions.name: addForceAtPosition
description: Adds a force to a rigid-body at the given position in world space, affecting both its linear and angular velocity.
#### Force accumulation
Forces are accumulated until the next physics step.
To clear the accumulated forces, call [clearForce](#Physics.clearForce).

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to add the force to.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force to add.

parameters.name: globalPosition
parameters.description: Global position to add the force to.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The force mode.

functions.name: clearForce
functions.description: Clears the currently accumulated forces of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The force mode of the forces to clear.

functions.name: clearTorque
functions.description: Clears the currently accumulated torques of a rigid body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity with the rigid body.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The force mode of the torques to clear.

functions.name: getArticulationRoot
description: Returns the root of the articulation which this entity is a part of.
Throws if the entity is not part of an articulation.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to get the articulation root of.

returns.name: articulationRoot
returns.description: The entity at the root of the articulation.

functions.name: getArticulationParent
description: Returns the parent of an entity's articulation link.
Throws if the entity is not part of an articulation.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to get the parent link of.

returns.name: parent
returns.description: Parent articulation link, or `nil` if this entity was the root link.

functions.name: getArticulationChildren
description: Returns the child links of an entity's articulation link.
Throws if the entity is not part of an articulation.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to get the child links of.

returns.name: children
returns.description: Child articulation links.

functions.name: setJointParentFrame
functions.description: Sets the position and orientation of the joint in the parent's local space.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity with the joint.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position relative to the parent.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Orientation relative to the parent.

functions.name: setJointChildFrame
functions.description: Sets the position and orientation of the joint in the child's local space.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity with the joint.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position relative to the child.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Orientation relative to the child.

functions.name: setJointType
functions.description: Sets the type of the joint, governing its degrees of freedom.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity with the joint.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type to set.

functions.name: setJointMotion
functions.description: Sets the motion of the joint along or about the degree of freedom.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity with the joint.

parameters.name: degreeOfFreedom
parameters.description: Linear or angular degree of freedom to modify.

parameters.name: motion
parameters.description: Type of motion.

functions.name: setJointLimits
description: Sets the limits of the joint's motion along or about the degree of freedom.
Does nothing unless the joint motion is set to `Limited`.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity with the joint.

parameters.name: degreeOfFreedom
parameters.description: Linear or angular degree of freedom to modify.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Minimum translation along or rotation about the degree of freedom.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum translation along or rotation about the degree of freedom.

functions.name: createCollider
functions.description: Creates a new collider with geometry and mass properties.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: Geometry to use.

returns.name: collider
returns.description: The created collider.

functions.name: attachCollider
description: Attaches the collider to an entity's rigid-body.
Colliders may only be attached to one rigid-body at a time.

parameters.name: collider
parameters.description: Collider to attach.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to attach to.

functions.name: detachCollider
description: Detaches the collider from its rigid-body.
Throws if not attached to a rigid-body (check with `getColliderEntity`).

parameters.name: collider
parameters.description: Collider to detach.

functions.name: getColliders
functions.description: Gets all colliders attached to the entity's rigid-body.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to get the colliders of.

returns.name: colliders
returns.description: List of attached colliders.

functions.name: getColliderEntity
functions.description: Gets the entity this collider is attached to.

parameters.name: collider
parameters.description: Collider to get the entity of.

returns.name: entity
returns.description: Entity this collider is attached to, or `nil` if not attached.

functions.name: getLocalPosition
functions.description: Gets the local position of the collider when attached to a rigid-body.

functions.name: setLocalPosition
functions.description: Sets the local position of the collider when attached to a rigid-body.

functions.name: getLocalOrientation
functions.description: Gets the local orientation of the collider when attached to a rigid-body.

functions.name: setLocalOrientation
functions.description: Sets the local orientation of the collider when attached to a rigid-body.

functions.name: getSimulationEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether the collider participates in the physics simulation.

functions.name: setSimulationEnabled
functions.description: Sets whether the collider participates in the physics simulation.

functions.name: getSceneQueriesEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether the collider participates in scene queries (ray-casts, sweeps and overlap tests).

functions.name: setSceneQueriesEnabled
functions.description: Sets whether the collider participates in scene queries (ray-casts, sweeps and overlap tests).

functions.name: createController
description: Creates a new PhysX character controller with the given options.
This is a very low level API which requires you to determine the displacement for the controller each frame
(including applying gravity and tracking whether the controller is grounded).
In most cases you'll want to use one of the provided character controllers in the `/character-controllers` folder.
If you do need to implement your own character controller from scratch,
you should read through https://nvidia-omniverse.github.io/PhysX/physx/5.4.2/docs/CharacterControllers.html first.

returns.name: controller
returns.description: Box or capsule controller depending on `options.shape`.

functions.name: moveController
description: Apply a displacement vector to the given character controller, performing collision checks on surrounding geometry.
The displacement should be premultiplied by the time between this and the previous `moveController` call if the rate of movement should be framerate independent.

parameters.name: displacement
parameters.description: Displacement relative to the controller's centre

parameters.name: minDistance
parameters.description: Minimum distance below which the displacement (after applying collision) will be considered as no movement.

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: Time (in seconds) between this and the previous `moveController` call.

functions.name: setControllerHeight
functions.description: Sets the controller's height, not including the contact offset (aka skin) or the radius (for capsule controllers).

functions.name: setControllerSideExtent
functions.description: Sets the size of the box controller's collider on the left/right axis.

functions.name: setControllerForwardExtent
functions.description: Sets the size of the box controller's collider on the forward/backward axis.

functions.name: setControllerRadius
functions.description: Sets the cylinder and end cap radius of the capsule controller's collider

functions.name: setControllerPosition
description: Sets the controller's position without performing any collision or overlap tests.
You should ensure that the position has sufficient space for the controller's collider.

functions.name: setControllerFootPosition
description: Sets the controller's position without performing any collision or overlap tests.
You should ensure that the position has sufficient space for the controller's collider.
Similar to `Physics.setControllerPosition`, except the vector positions the bottom extent of the collider (including contact offset)
as opposed to the centre.

functions.name: setControllerUpDirection
description: Sets the up direction of the controller, adjusting the collider rotation and auto-stepping.
TODO: Check if this transforms the displacement vector passed to `Physics.moveController` and document either way.

functions.name: setControllerStepOffset
description: Sets the step offset of the controller.

functions.name: getControllerPosition
functions.description: Gets the position of the controller's centre.

functions.name: getControllerFootPosition
functions.description: Gets the position of the bottom extent of the controller's collider (including contact offset).

functions.name: getControllerUpDirection
functions.description: Gets the up direction of the controller.

functions.name: getControllerStepOffset
functions.description: Gets the step offset of the controller.

functions.name: createSphere
functions.description: Creates a sphere geometry with the given radius.

functions.name: createCapsule
description: Creates a capsule geometry with the given radius and half height.
The total height can be calculated as `2 * (radius + halfHeight)`.
The capsule is oriented along the X-axis in the geometry's local coordinate space.
To orient it vertically when creating a shape, set the shape's local orientation to a 90 degree rotation about the Z-axis.

parameters.name: halfHeight
parameters.description: Distance from the origin to the centre of the end caps.

functions.name: createBox
functions.description: Creates a box geometry with the given half extents along the geometry's local axes.

parameters.name: halfExtents
parameters.description: Distance from the origin to the sides of the box on each axis.

functions.name: createPlane
description: Creates a plane geometry at the origin of the geometry's local coordinate space.
Everything below the plane (-X in the local coordinate space) is considered as colliding with it.

functions.name: setSceneQueryResponse
functions.description: Sets the response for this collider on a given scene query channel.

parameters.name: collider
parameters.description: The collider to modify.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The channel to set the response of.

parameters.name: response
parameters.description: The response to scene queries on this channel.

functions.name: raycast
functions.description: Traces a ray along a given direction up to an (optional) max distance.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Starting point of the ray.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction along which to trace the ray.

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: Optional maximum distance to trace before returning a miss.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: See documentation for `RaycastOptions`. Pass `nil` to use all defaults.

returns.name: result
returns.description: See documentation for `RaycastResult`.

functions.name: sweep
description: Sweeps a geometry along a given direction up to an (optional) max distance.
An optional 'skin' or contact offset can be defined around the geometry to avoid issues resulting from floating point imprecision.
Contacts will be generated if any part of the geometry _or_ skin hit another object.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: Geometry to sweep.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Starting point of the geometry.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Orientation of the geometry in world space.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Direction along which to sweep the geometry.

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: Optional maximum distance to sweep before returning a miss.

parameters.name: skin
parameters.description: Optional 'skin' around the geometry to start generating intersections in.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: See documentation for `RaycastOptions`. Pass `nil` to use all defaults.

returns.name: result
returns.description: See documentation for `RaycastResult`.

functions.name: overlap
functions.description: Finds all objects overlapping a geometry.

parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: Geometry to test with.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Position of the geometry.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: Orientation of the geometry.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: See documentation for `OverlapOptions`. Pass `nil` to use all defaults.

returns.name: entities
returns.description: Entities overlapping the geometry.

constants.name: IS_DEBUGGER_AVAILABLE
constants.description: Whether the physics debugger is available. True on debug builds, false otherwise.

classes.name: ControllerCreateOptions
description: Options passed to `Physics.createController`.
Most properties have sensible defaults which will be used when no value is given.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Which collider to use.

properties.name: height
properties.description: Height of the collider. For capsules this excludes the radius of the end caps.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: Radius of the collider. Ignored when `shape` is `Box`.

properties.name: climbingMode
properties.description: How the capsule interacts with obstacles taller than `stepOffset`.

properties.name: sideExtent
properties.description: Size of the collider on the left/right axis. Ignored when `shape` is `Capsule`.

properties.name: forwardExtent
properties.description: Size of the collider on the forward/backward axis. Ignored when `shape` is `Capsule`.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Initial position of the controller's centre.

properties.name: upDirection
properties.description: Up direction of the collider.

properties.name: slopeLimit
properties.description: Maximum slope angle before the controller is unable to move up it (as the cosine of the angle).

properties.name: nonWalkableMode
properties.description: How the controller reacts to non-walkable surfaces (defined by `slopeLimit`).

properties.name: invisibleWallHeight
properties.description: Set greater than `0` to automatically generate wall colliders around non-walkable surfaces.

properties.name: maxJumpHeight
properties.description: If `invisibleWallHeight` is greater than `0`, extends the detection range for nearby surfaces.

properties.name: contactOffset
properties.description: Size of the skin around the collider used to handle precision issues when detecting collisions.

properties.name: stepOffset
properties.description: Maximum height of an obstacle that can be walked over. Capsule controllers can still slide over obstacles taller than this, unless `nonWalkableMode` is `Constrained`.

properties.name: density
properties.description: Density of the underlying kinematic PhysX actor.

properties.name: scaleCoefficient
properties.description: Scale factor of the underlying kinematic PhysX actor. Should be < 1 to avoid pushing objects through walls.

properties.name: volumeGrowth
properties.description: Size of the region around the controller to cache. Must be between 1 and 2.

classes.name: ControllerMoveResult
classes.description: Contains information about what happened during `Physics.moveController`.

properties.name: hasSideCollisions
properties.description: True if any collision events occurred this move to the controller's sides

properties.name: hasTopCollisions
properties.description: True if any collision events occurred this move to the top of the controller

properties.name: hasBottomCollisions
properties.description: True if any collision events occurred this move to the bottom of the controller

classes.name: RaycastOptions
description: Configures raycast and sweep queries for the desired behaviour and performance.
All properties can be left defaulted to sensible values, maintaining expected behaviour while minimising performance impact from the more specialised features.

properties.name: anyHit
properties.description: True to end the trace early on _any_ blocking hit, not just closest.

properties.name: dontBlock
properties.description: Causes all intersected objects to be considered 'touching' hits, allowing the query to move through objects.

properties.name: includeStatic
properties.description: Toggles inclusion of static rigid-bodies in the query.

properties.name: includeDynamic
properties.description: Toggles inclusion of dynamic rigid-bodies in the query.

properties.name: includeTouching
properties.description: Collects hits for non-blocking objects, or all objects if `dontBlock` is `true`.

properties.name: includePosition
properties.description: Toggles calculation of hit position on all results.

properties.name: includeNormal
properties.description: Toggles calculation of hit normal on all results.

properties.name: includeUv
properties.description: Toggles inclusion of face UV on results which hit a triangle mesh or height field.

properties.name: includeMtd
properties.description: Toggles calculation of Minimum Translational Distance for initial overlaps.

properties.name: channel
properties.description: Which channel should this query intersect with.

properties.name: excludedColliders
properties.description: List of colliders to exclude from blocking and touching hits.

classes.name: RaycastResultHit
classes.description: A blocking or touching hit returned from a ray or sweep scene query. The contents will depend on the `RaycastOptions` passed to the query method.

properties.name: entity
properties.description: Entity that was hit, or `nil` if object isn't linked to an entity.

properties.name: distance
properties.description: Distance travelled along the query's direction. MTD if `includeMtd` was `true` and the query had initial overlap.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Hit position, or `nil` if `includePosition` was `false`.

properties.name: normal
properties.description: Hit normal, or `nil` if `includeNormal` was `false`.

properties.name: uv
properties.description: Hit UV, or `nil` if `includeUv` was `false` or the hit object isn't a mesh.

properties.name: hadInitialOverlap
properties.description: True if the query had initial overlap with an object at the origin.

classes.name: RaycastResult
classes.description: Result of a ray or sweep scene query.

properties.name: blockingHit
properties.description: Closest blocking hit if the query generated one.

properties.name: touchingHits
properties.description: List of touching hits the query generated. Empty if no touching hits or `includeTouching` was `false`.

classes.name: OverlapOptions
description: Configures overlap queries for the desired behaviour and performance.
All properties can be left defaulted to sensible values, maintaining expected behaviour while minimising performance impact from the more specialised features.

properties.name: includeStatic
properties.description: Toggles inclusion of static rigid-bodies in the query.

properties.name: includeDynamic
properties.description: Toggles inclusion of dynamic rigid-bodies in the query.

properties.name: channel
properties.description: Which channel should this query intersect with.

properties.name: excludedColliders
properties.description: List of colliders to exclude from overlaps.

enums.name: ForceMode
enums.description: Force modes which describe the unit of the force or torque given to `addForce` and `addTorque`.

enums.name: ControllerShape
enums.description: Collider shape to use for character controllers.

enums.name: ClimbingMode
enums.description: Climbing mode to use for capsule character controllers ([PhysX Docs](https://nvidia-omniverse.github.io/PhysX/physx/5.4.2/docs/CharacterControllers.html#climbing-mode))

enums.name: NonWalkableMode
enums.description: How the character controller should handle non-walkable surfaces (e.g. steep slopes)

enums.name: JointType
enums.description: Joint types governing which limits and drives are supported for the joint.

enums.name: JointMotion
enums.description: Allowed motion of the joint along or about a degree of freedom.

enums.name: DegreeOfFreedom
enums.description: Degrees of freedom along or about which a joint can move.

enums.name: SceneQueryChannel
description: Channels which can be used to filter scene query hits, each with its own semantic meaning.
Colliders can be configured to generate blocking or touching hits for each channel, or even to discard the hit entirely.
You should aim to follow the semantic meanings of the channels where possible, e.g. by using Bullet for raycast weapons
and then configuring the colliders for any glass panes to only generate touching hits on that channel.
This ensures as much interoperability as possible between various assets, games and addons.

enums.name: SceneQueryResponse
enums.description: Controls how colliders should respond to scene queries.

events.name: tick
events.description: Fires every time the physics engine is ticked (at the fixed physics timestep).

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: The time in seconds since the last physics tick (the fixed timestep).
